summary: Small enrichment rather than a new question. While preparing a witness-commit probe, the captured package's own tests turned out to assert that behavior directly: TestWitnessReplication, built on setUpLeaderAndWitness, proposes an entry and requires it to commit on both leader and witness with the witness match advanced. Recorded those two test-expectation anchors and revised the existing witness-commit behavior entry to cite them alongside the source reads; the premise is unchanged, so no interpretation or use was rewritten. No execution was run this turn.
